_doc: ADR-551 · Artifact provenance registry — the ONE place that records WHY a significant artifact exists, WHO owns it and WHAT authorized it. Only facts a human or a decision supplies live here; git facts (first/last commit, model co-authors, session links, ADR/cycle refs, release) are DERIVED at query time by spa_core/studio_os/provenance.py, so they cannot go stale. Data artifacts of fleet agents are resolved from architecture/manifest.json (producer, consumers, passport goal) and are NOT duplicated here. UNKNOWN means the link could not be proven — never «safe to remove». Status vocabulary: ACTIVE · EXPERIMENTAL · SUPERSEDED · DEPRECATED · UNKNOWN_PURPOSE.
